caption:
Your phone can back up photos for you. 📸

Open your photo app's settings and switch on backup. Common choices: Google Photos or iCloud Photos.
Check that it finishes, and that you have enough storage.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#phonetips #photos #backup #googlephotos #icloud #productivity #digitalorganization #techtips #lifehacks #techmendly

scenes.text: Lose your phone, lose every photo?
scenes.say: Lose your phone, lose every photo? Not if backup is on.

scenes.title: Turn on photo backup
scenes.say: Open your photo app's settings. Switch on backup. Then check that you have enough storage.

scenes.title: Google Photos or iCloud
scenes.body: Use the one that matches your phone.
scenes.say: Most phones already include one. Google Photos on Android, or iCloud Photos on iPhone. Use the one that matches your phone.
Without backup, a lost phone can mean lost photos. With backup on, a new phone gets them back.

scenes.sub: A new tech tip every day
scenes.say: Save this and check your settings today. Follow TechMendly for a new tech tip every day.
